judge.rationale: The candidate delivers every requirement in the ticket, including the single-compilation test for static schemas across 10 `execute` calls which the reference actually omitted. In `.specify/spec.md`, the candidate missed explicitly noting that extra properties pass through unmodified, though it documented this everywhere else (`specs/`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`). Technically, the candidate promoted the transitive `ajv@^6.12.6` already in the lockfile rather than installing `ajv@^8.17.1` as the reference did, and used a module-level `Ajv` instance with custom error formatting rather than an instance-level `Ajv` relying on default messages. Finally, the candidate left behind untracked/scratch harness artifacts (`.lore/dod.md` and `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`) and an unrequested version bump in `package.json`.
